long_biography.plain_text:
Zartler trained as a mechanical engineer before earning an MBA and entering the energy industry. At Dynegy, he built and managed a natural-gas-liquids business. He later co-founded Denham Capital, where he led global investments in midstream infrastructure and oilfield services, combining operating experience with private-equity discipline.

In 2013, Zartler created Solaris Energy Capital to build emerging energy businesses. Its ventures included a public oilfield-infrastructure company and a water-handling platform designed around recycling in the Permian Basin. As chairman and co-chief executive, he has since steered Solaris toward distributed power systems serving energy and data-centre customers.
